entry.title: 82 entries re-checked on 30 Sep 2026: 7 with new commits, 3 new releases, 0 grade changes, 0 main-link failures; 47 videos re-checked: all available, 0 removed; 12 entries and 2 videos added.

New page Does fly wiring help?: 31 control studies side by side. Sometimes: real fly wiring beat scrambled wiring in 10 of 23 studies, mostly reflex, sensory and steering circuits; in trained, reservoir and ML tasks it tied or lost (7). The fly network beats a no-brain baseline in only 2 of 13. Only 9 studies are strong; numbers are the authors'.
New data file controls.json with its JSON Schema: every study's arms, source files, retention and rule-based wiring effect, fairness and quality labels.

Is it real?: new verdict on FlyLeno, "Tonight's host: Grey Leno, piloted by Drosophila melanogaster" (grade B, borderline C: the whole FlyWire brain runs untrained, but gait, homing and action choice are engineered and there is no control).

Is it real?: the DOOMFLY row adds the Doom control study's sweep of 12 autopilot settings: the best survives 53.44 s against DOOMFLY's 53.34 s, next to the matched autopilot's 51.93 s. The controls section now points to the 31-study ledger instead of its 20-study table.

Re-checked without change: the Pokémon stream and the Rainbow Six claim (both U), flydoom by mutkuoz (new commits concern a separate variant; stays A) and Haltere (round-6 flights, still no race finish; stays C).

12 new catalogue entries: 2 A (fly-cartpole, flybrain-connectome-benchmark), 5 B (FlyLeno, FlyKart, Open Fly, Fly With Me, Fly-NAF), 2 C (making-fly-play-chess, FlyCNS Tic-Tac-Toe), 1 D (FLYBRAIN Bad Apple x DOOM) and 2 data tools (connectome_interpreter, FlyBrainLab).

New releases re-checked: acamilo-flybrain v0.6.7 (damage reward; stays C), FlyWire annotations Version 3.2.0 (annotation release, not a new connectome) and Kick the Fly 2.13.1 (tests and tooling; stays C).

projects.json and its schema gain two optional fields on every record: controls (wiring-null 22, baseline-only 8, none 64) and wiring_effect; the catalogue filter gains a Controls filter. Additive: no field removed or renamed.
2 new videos: Vinesauce's FlyLeno stream (B), labelled as a streamer's playthrough, not the author's upload, and Fly-NAF's best run (B), the author's upload.
Lead scan: 1 claim promoted (FlyLeno); Leetzerzz's Pokémon stream and the Rainbow Six claim unchanged; 0 link failures and 0 video removals.
Build your own: pins unchanged after a PyPI check (full re-test due by 12 Oct 2026); the Add a body path states that FlyGym 2.1.0 needs Python 3.12 to 3.14 and that brain-body coupling is untested.
Research report of the fourth check: the controls ledger, the FlyLeno verdict, 12 new entries, method and limits.
73 entries re-checked on 29 Sep 2026: 3 with new commits and releases, 1 re-graded (DesktopFly B to C), all main links responding; 44 videos re-checked: all available; 9 entries and 3 videos added.

Is it real?: new verdict on the Raspberry Pi 5 "fly plays Pokémon" Twitch stream (grade U: no code; input read from game memory by the creator's account, unpublished decoder, chat steers learning). The open-source acamilo/flybrain and fly-plays-games (both C) are not the stream's code.

Is it real?: new verdict on "a fly's digital brain plays Rainbow Six Siege" (grade U: nothing published; over 1,000,000 neurons matches no fly connectome; skill would come from training on human gameplay).

DesktopFly re-graded from B (borderline C) to C: neuron rates only switch coded animations, sleep follows idle time and the clock. Verdict row corrected, and a new project page with a download-lure warning.
Is it real?: a new grade A wiring test (fly-brain-zero-shot) shown next to the Doom test: scrambled wiring stops a whole-brain fly steering to targets (2.96 vs 0.34 poles per 10 s).

9 new catalogue entries: 1 A (fly-brain-zero-shot), 4 C (acamilo-flybrain, fly-plays-games, fruitfly-roblox, NeuroWeave), 2 U (the Pokémon stream, the Rainbow Six claim) and 2 data tools (fly-connectome-template, fafbseg).

New releases re-checked: Kick the Fly 2.12.0 (larva brain for headless tests, whose validation fails; stays C), Haltere fast-brain-11 (one full lap, no race finish; stays C) and neuprint-python 0.6.4 (client update).
